title: Jamia Masjid Thal
subtitle: Wooden mosque on the Panjkora bank, Thal village, Kumrat

landmark.name: Jamia Masjid Thal
edits: The mosque is drawn in the landmark module from two CC BY-SA Commons photos (Asfandyarlahor and Asad Ullah); it is not a survey, and OSM maps no footprint for it.

Estimated, not measured: the stone base and ground floor 21 x 15 m with the floor line at 3.6 m; the upper storey an open gallery 4.2 m tall; the low hipped roof about 2 m high with 1.2 m eaves; the three-tier tower (6, 4.5 and 3 m square, 1.6 m each) rising to about 17 m; the posts, lattice screens, balusters and the two gate pillars (about 5 m).

The paint (grey timber, green, red and yellow bands and balusters, white gate pillars and tower finial) follows the photos; the carving is simplified to bands and the lattice is drawn as crossed slats.
The ground within 30 m of the mosque is levelled to its base; the rest of the village is the DEM slope, and its houses are not mapped in OSM so they are not drawn.
